reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 16 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked white-topped navy cap and gold badge, covered hair, brows, no amplified facial hair, one mouth, navy high collar without tie, collar fit, backplate, upper/lower note footprint and missing right tab.

remaining_reasons: The returned native note adds a separate gray mark cluster at the LOWER RIGHT of the paper, outside the original upper marking footprint. The enlarged original has no corresponding lower-right cluster and retains mostly blank lower paper. Remove the added cluster and restore only the source's existing faint upper marks and original blank areas without substituting stains or glyphs.

The source's small dark right-edge note tab is absent from the returned note's plain right edge. Restore the original compact dark tab and its position/form without substituting a tear, fold or different hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The white/light-gray topped navy cap retains its dark band, one gold front badge and glossy black visor. Hairline and most sideburns remain covered, with dark brows and no glasses. The existing upper-lip/mouth shading remains one reserved closed mouth without an amplified moustache or beard. The three-quarter left presentation, tight crop and warm directional light with deep visor shadow remain. The dark navy high-collared uniform keeps one small gold collar detail and no tie. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The cream note retains two upper mark rows. The dark olive-gray photographic backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the added lower-right gray cluster and missing right tab remain separate visible rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: Cap shadow and the 65x67 size leave very fine upper-lip hair, exact cap/collar motifs and note glyphs unresolved, and these are not rejection grounds. The rejection relies on the clearly visible lower-right gray cluster and absent right-edge tab in native/enlarged comparisons, not on interpreting small writing, paper texture or alpha numbers.
